body:
Track delivery of the approved [Esmer Market implementation plan](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/7c0dfee0abda9793fafa7e1145d6603d050fa69b/docs/superpowers/plans/esmer-market-implementation-plan.md). Each phase has one child issue containing its original task checklists, files, interfaces, verification commands, and exit gate.

Phases 1 through 10 form the first release. Phase 11 is a separate, conditional release boundary. All application execution and acceptance gates remain open.

Issue creation authorizes tracking only. Application implementation, renewed source inspection, installation on Eralp's computer, and production integration require their applicable separate approvals. Product acceptance and explicit live-access permission remain prerequisites for Phase 11.

## Authoritative documents

- [Foundation specification](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/7c0dfee0abda9793fafa7e1145d6603d050fa69b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-design.md).
- [Database audit](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/7c0dfee0abda9793fafa7e1145d6603d050fa69b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-audit.md).
- [Release acceptance checklist](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/7c0dfee0abda9793fafa7e1145d6603d050fa69b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-acceptance.md).
- [Plan dependencies](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/7c0dfee0abda9793fafa7e1145d6603d050fa69b/docs/superpowers/plans/esmer-market-implementation-plan.md#phases-at-a-glance).
- [Shared implementation decisions](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/7c0dfee0abda9793fafa7e1145d6603d050fa69b/docs/superpowers/plans/esmer-market-implementation-plan.md#implementation-structure-and-decisions).
- [Execution and evidence rules](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/7c0dfee0abda9793fafa7e1145d6603d050fa69b/docs/superpowers/plans/esmer-market-implementation-plan.md#execution-and-evidence-rules).

## Phase issues

### First release

- [ ] #4 Phase 1: Independent foundation
- [ ] #5 Phase 2: Source contract and independent test evidence
- [ ] #6 Phase 3: Read-only extraction and analytics packages
- [ ] #7 Phase 4: Durable local storage and safe imports
- [ ] #8 Phase 5: Sales analytics and traceability
- [ ] #9 Phase 6: Historical estimates, purchasing and supplier returns
- [ ] #10 Phase 7: Expenses, adjustments and operating results
- [ ] #11 Phase 8: Complete Turkish reporting, report revisions and Excel export
- [ ] #12 Phase 9: Encrypted backup and independent recovery
- [ ] #13 Phase 10: Windows acceptance and reveal package

### Conditional later release

- [ ] #14 Phase 11: Conditional live integration

Native blocking relationships match the plan dependency table. Phase 11 depends on external acceptance and permissions, which remain explicit in its issue.

## Global constraints

- One store, one owner, one trusted local computer; Windows is the deployment target.
- Turkish-only interface and Turkish presentation conventions; English internal code/domain identifiers. TRY only.
- The business is in the TRNC/KKTC. Do not import legal or tax assumptions from another jurisdiction.
- The market database and operational system remain strictly read-only to the application, permanently.
- Development uses isolated restored backups. Prefer a newer supplied backup for the reveal when available; preserve its actual coverage and cutoff.
- Dashboards read only the local analytics store. The surprise build works offline and has live access disabled.
- No application login, PIN, roles, multi-user features, required subscription or paid cloud service.
- Do not import identifiable customer information or employee-level payroll. Monthly labour totals are sufficient.
- Historical cost is an explicitly labelled last-purchase estimate after source semantics are validated. It is not weighted-average inventory valuation.
- Missing cost, incomplete expenses and unknown KDV treatment remain missing or unknown. Owner acknowledgement cannot turn an estimate into exact cost.
- Profitability follows incurred periods; payment views use payment dates. Financing, owner funds, transfers and asset purchases are not silently operating expenses.
- Every released KPI retains population, source, batch, method, confidence and adjustment provenance.
- Source refreshes preserve expenses, settings, adjustments, audit history and accepted reports. Accepted versions cannot change silently.
- Excel import/export and encrypted, independently recoverable backups are first-release requirements.
- Preserve the performance and freshness acceptance targets in the approved specification; this plan does not restate them as project scheduling information.
- Do not copy legacy runtime code, migrations or Git history into the new repository. Do not commit private backups, credentials or unreviewed source data.
- Exclude PDF export, forecasts/AI, multi-store, multi-currency, customer analytics, statutory declarations and manual supplier-claim processing from the first release.

## Coverage and completion ledger

| Approved requirement | Implementing phases | Required evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D01, D18 — Windows and performance | 1, 8, 10 | Smoke build, full dataset measurements and clean lifecycle tests |
| D02, D03 — Turkish/TRY and KKTC boundaries | 2, 5–8, 10 | Source semantics, Turkish UI/Excel checks, absence of unsupported statutory claims |
| D04 — Permanent source read-only access | 1–3, 11 | Privilege review, isolated account denial/read evidence and workflow traces |
| D05, D06 — Backup reveal and conditional live access | 2–4, 10, 11 | Package lineage/cutoff and separate L01 rollout gate |
| D07 — Separate analytics store | 1, 4, 5, 11 | Offline reports and identical package/live normalization contracts |
| D08 — No login; safe desktop boundaries | 1, 9 | Renderer/IPC tests and recovery without daily authentication |
| D09 — Encrypted independent recovery | 9, 10 | Machine-loss restore and safe-failure exercises |
| D10 — Customer/employee privacy | 2, 3, 7, 10 | Allowlist, sentinel checks, aggregate labour and package inventory |
| D11 — Spreadsheet expenses and corrections | 7 | Preview/confirm, duplicates, provenance and reversible history tests |
| D12 — Supplier returns | 2, 6 | Conversion reconciliation and evidenced settlement-state tests |
| D13 — Historical versus replacement cost | 2, 6 | G02–G04 and coverage/precision cases |
| D14 — Incurred expense and classification rules | 7 | G05/G06, excluded cash classifications and no duplicate losses |
| D15 — KPI traceability | 4–8 | Version-pinned summary/detail/source and export reconciliation |
| D16 — Incomplete periods and immutable reports | 4, 5, 7, 8 | Partial-period states, revision comparisons and G08 |
| D17 — Excel and first-release exclusions | 7, 8, 10 | Workbook round-trip and release scope inspection |
| D19, D20 — Approved stack and independent rebuild | 1, 10 | Dependency/runtime record and clean repository/release inventory |
| A01 — Source safety | 1–3, 11 | Complete lifecycle plus scoped permission evidence |
| A02 — Calculation correctness | 2, 5–7 | Reviewed oracles and focused/integration regression results |
| A03 — Confidence and traceability | 5–8 | Golden reports, Turkish screenshots and revision walkthrough |
| A04 — Import and data preservation | 4, 7–9 | Failure injection, overlap and ownership comparisons |
| A05 — Privacy/local boundaries | 1–3, 7, 10 | Allowlist/sentinel tests and release-content inspection |
| A06 — Recovery | 9 | Independent clean restore and financial equivalence |
| A07 — Packaging, usability and performance | 1, 8, 10 | Windows lifecycle, measured full-data behaviour and Excel evidence |
| L01 — Later live integration | 11 | Permission, consistency, reconciliation, impact and rollout evidence |

Repository setup and transfer of the approved planning artifacts are complete. All application execution checkboxes and release gates remain open. No application code, source reconnection or release action is represented as completed.

comments.body:
PR #17 merged as `4240576d47c98f1c967e361a51f28ca5a3042d44`, and issue #6 is closed at the user's direction for the delivered synthetic Phase 3 scope. The merged tree exactly matches the tested head `552569ede50df056be43a75804d5930d6a8a3a2e`.

The [closure evidence and remaining gates](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/issues/6#issuecomment-5717701292) remain part of this delivery tracker. In particular, the source-dependent Phase 3 exit gate stays open for restricted SQL Server account/driver proof, reviewed real mapping and real-data privacy. Reconciliation, financial behavior, Phase 4 activation/preservation, recovery and full-volume Windows acceptance also remain open in their implementing phases. Issue closure does not pass those acceptance gates. No Phase 4 work or renewed source access occurred.

The user requested a throwaway clickable prototype of the 2026-09-25 UI redesign specification. It is captured outside main on `codex/ui-redesign-prototype` at `cf01315965382a9d1bf51ce5b704e0e2784a77a5`.

[Prototype and run instructions](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/tree/codex/ui-redesign-prototype/src/ui/redesign-prototype) · [Verification and limitations](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/cf01315965382a9d1bf51ce5b704e0e2784a77a5/src/ui/redesign-prototype/VERIFICATION.md).

The design question is which presentation makes monthly net sales and supporting evidence easiest to scan. A is the financial statement, B uses sidebar navigation and two content columns, and C is a denser ledger. A is recommended as closest to the confirmed brief. The user's layout preference remains pending.

Run `npm run prototype:ui`, then open `http://127.0.0.1:4178/?variant=A`. All values and operations are synthetic, in memory and simulated. The production app is unchanged. Browser checks covered representative interactions and 1440/680/453 CSS-pixel views; Node syntax and diff checks passed. Actual Windows scaling, forced colors, packaged-app verification and A03/A07 acceptance remain separate. No source inspection, owner contact, installation, production access or new implementation phase occurred. No PR was opened.
